title: Refuse a decision whose step differs from the step in progress
why: No caller writes an explicit past step: the only production caller is the agent-flow-decision command, whose rule forbids setting step. Refusing fails loud; overwriting would hide a spoof attempt.
rejected: Overwrite the given step with the step in progress

title: Compare the given step against the plan's step in progress, reading the plan for every decision
why: A given step must be checked against the plan, so the early return that skipped the plan read had to go; one code path now covers absent, equal, different and no-step-in-progress.
rejected: Overwrite the given step with the step in progress
Validate only when the step differs, reading the plan lazily

title: Class plan-read-to-append TOCTOU and plan.json trust root as accepted residuals, not findings
why: A step change between the plan read and the append only files the decision under the step that was in progress at read time, never one the caller chose; plan.json integrity is outside S2, and closing the gap needs a lock shared with the step-timing hooks, which would be out of proportion for this fix
rejected: Report as a low finding requiring a lock
Report as a medium finding on plan.json trust
